_doc: Hosted-mode lock on Raven's WebUI (agents-raven.md Contract E; items enterpriseaiframework-250, -7cd). An ALLOW-LIST, read by app/raven_write_lock.py on every frame: a call passes only if its method is EXACTLY one of `allow`, or one of `allow_when_key` with params.key EXACTLY one of that method's keys. Everything else is refused, including unknown methods, aliases and case/separator variants. `refuse` is the reviewed classification of the rest (the gate never reads it; the tests require every method the image registers to be classified). Verified against the hosted image raven-hosted:v0.2.3-eaf2 (raven 0.2.3, upstream a9765e55); the registrations are recorded in control-plane/tests/fixtures/raven_v0.2.3_rpc_methods.json.
